first_success.name: Create one named test workspace and see its dashboard containing the starter task.

would_return_reason: Simulated breaker judgment: the main start action failed to open the creation flow, so I stopped at that first error.

issues.summary: Main Start a workspace link changes only the URL fragment; no creation form opens.
issues.reproduction: 1. Open http://127.0.0.1:4179/ in a fresh isolated session with empty localStorage, sessionStorage and cookies. 2. Set viewport to 1280x800. 3. Click the main Start a workspace link once. 4. Inspect the resulting page and browser storage.
issues.expected: A workspace creation form opens so the synthetic workspace Breaker Test Cabin can be named and created.
issues.actual: URL became http://127.0.0.1:4179/#start; the landing page remained visible. A subsequent accessibility snapshot showed no creation form. DOM inspection found zero forms and no element with id start. LocalStorage and sessionStorage remained empty and document.cookie was empty. No workspace dashboard or starter task appeared.
